limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full text of Kishi's 2008 article was not inspected, although its abstract and its principal results as restated in the 2026 Chakraborty-Rao-Dabhole preprint were inspected; because it treats the same family, this is the main residual originality risk. The result gives lower bounds on 2-rank and class-number divisibility, not the full 2-primary class group or elements of exact order 2^R, and no density or optimized construction size is claimed. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
provenance: A class-group refinement of Kishi's Fibonacci-parametrized imaginary quadratic family, using primitive divisors of Fibonacci numbers, valuation parity control, Gauss genus theory, and a fixed-quartic infinitude argument.
record_title: Unbounded 2-rank inside Kishi's Fibonacci class-number-five family
